_doc: EP04 soundtrack. Same music beds and effect prompts as EP03 (placed for this story), so tools/soundtrack.py copies EP03's recordings instead of making new ones: nothing new is paid for.

music.prompt: Dark minimal ambient underscore for a true-crime documentary: a low, patient analog synth drone with one cold, soft pulse every few seconds. 1980s synthesizer texture, slow, restrained, no drums, no vocals, no melody.
Documentary underscore: a bright, optimistic 1980s analog synth pad, like a period technology advert, that slowly turns cold and minor, thinning out. Sparse, no drums, no vocals.
Tense minimal electronic underscore: a single sustained tone rising very slowly, one detuned note, faint glitchy digital textures, cold and quiet, building unease. No drums, no vocals, no melody.

Cold minimal documentary underscore: a steady, unchanging mechanical pulse like a machine working alone at night, clockwork analog synth, repetitive, with a low swell at the very end. No vocals, no melody.
Restrained, formal documentary underscore: a measured, quiet synth pulse that eases into a cold low drone. Minimal, serious, 1980s analog texture. No drums, no vocals.

Unresolved, uneasy ambient documentary underscore: a wide cold synth drone that slowly thins to a single held low note and stays suspended, never resolving. Sparse, quiet. No drums, no vocals, no melody.
